# ActionBar

Floating toolbar at the bottom centre for bulk actions on selected rows ("3 selected · Start · Stop · Delete").

`KenosUI.ActionBar` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.ActionBar>…</KenosUI.ActionBar>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.ActionBar">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Floating bar for bulk actions on selected table rows.
